mandatory_protocol: Publish nativePoseRequired before any persistent body1 pose admission. Read it from immutable private copied-save role/generation/epoch lease, not current Arm success. Every body1 refusal in RunJobWindow and DrainCall suppresses instead of forwarding original. Tri-state executed_windowed/executed_legacy/suppressed prevents caller fallback.

One actual atomic reader/writer exclusion domain covers every original WrapBatch from BEFORE original execution until its finally return, all global C0 updater execution, and the qualified global UI consumer/update entries. Existing counters remain telemetry only.

The outermost WrapBatch releases its shared exclusion ticket after the original join and before deferred drain. RunJobWindow uses a nonwaiting exclusive CAS from zero; writer busy, nested callback, batch busy, gate/type/epoch/capture refusal means no pose job. Never upgrade a retained shared ticket.

Exclusive ownership starts before BeginWindow and before SafePre, RatesStep, MirrorMag, SlotFollow, Quiet/UI hooks or any callback. It remains through job, probes, SafePost, typed C0/UI restoration and EndWindow; only afterward may writer release.

Global updater called reentrantly by the writer owner cannot wait or promote; refuse/suppress and record a private-lab failure. Foreign entrants cannot check a counter then fall through original. They wait for actual reader admission under a bounded private-lab timeout; timeout initiates owned supervisor cleanup and never executes the original while exclusive remains. A synchronous native join can make this a liveness failure, so normal activation remains disabled pending proof.

Keep token cleanup in outer POD-compatible SEH finally, independently fault-bounding SafePost and C0/UI restores so one fault cannot bypass another. Reconcile existing GuardedCall abnormal EndWindow to close exactly once. Failed SafePre prefix cleanup remains accounted for.

C0 cleanup uses the existing single-byte CAS once. UI capture/cleanup uses exact unchanged U/primary/VTable/P ownership and four qualified scalar fields, snapshot before callbacks, restore after SafePost while all qualified consumers are excluded. No active C0 byte or native setter calls. A failed/conflicting/partial restoration latches private-lab fault and retains exclusive ownership until supervised process termination; it must never release a corrupted shared presentation.

Stop admitting new writers on shutdown/scene-change but retain active cleanup authority and actor lifetime. Scene teardown/native actor replacement must participate in the same gate before destruction. Mod Configure/ReadArm flags do not prove native teardown exclusion.

All other wrappers that can execute swapped pad/local-id/camera/pose callbacks must participate in this domain; same-owner nested callback refusal cannot run original on the swapped shared fields. Native body1 pose callbacks outside the mandatory window remain prohibited.
blockers: Complete native body1 sleep/carry callback and null-synchronizer census is still incomplete. The C0 setter/hint leaf being safe does not qualify their caller transitives.

Native body1 original job and transitive callbacks are not proven free of synchronous foreign joins. Reader waiting may deadlock; bounded copied-process cleanup is mandatory for an experimental candidate, not production liveness proof.

All recovery-hint consumers, independent shared presentation entry paths, nested input windows and native scene-teardown paths are not yet qualified/covered. Known natural entries can be gated, but incomplete coverage must keep activation disabled.
Typed four-field UI restoration is a proposed separate owned scalar contract. Exact leaf writes establish field widths, not the exclusion/lifecycle of every consumer.
